description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the clinical team at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This pivotal role offers an annual salary range of $85,000 - $95,000 and the opportunity to significantly impact patient care and staff development. We are looking to fill this position promptly with a leader committed to excellence.

As the Director of Nursing, you will oversee all nursing operations, ensuring the highest standards of care and compliance with regulatory guidelines. This is an excellent opportunity for a visionary leader to foster a positive work environment and drive clinical excellence.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Iowa (or ability to obtain)
Minimum of 2-3 years of experience as a Director of Nursing or Assistant Director of Nursing in a skilled nursing facility
Strong knowledge of state and federal regulations for long-term care
Commitment to providing high-quality patient care
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $85,000 - $95,000 based on experience.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Olathe, KS. This leadership role offers a significant opportunity to contribute to the quality of patient care and staff development within a supportive environment. If you are a Registered Nurse with a passion for clinical excellence and team leadership, we encourage you to apply.

This position offers a competitive salary range of $75,000 - $85,000 per year. You will play a crucial role in overseeing nursing operations, ensuring compliance with healthcare regulations, and fostering a positive work environment for our nursing team. Join us and make a meaningful impact on the lives of our residents.
requirements: Experience in a skilled nursing or long-term care setting
Proven leadership or supervisory experience in nursing
Strong clinical assessment and critical thinking skills
Knowledge of state and federal healthcare regulations
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation based on experience, with a salary range of $75,000 - $85,000 per year.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Interim MDS Coordinator to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Olathe, KS. This is an excellent opportunity for a skilled professional to provide critical support during a transitional period, ensuring continuity of care and compliance.

The Interim MDS Coordinator will be responsible for completing accurate and timely Minimum Data Set (MDS) assessments, developing comprehensive care plans, and ensuring compliance with federal and state regulations. This role is vital in facilitating appropriate reimbursement and maintaining high standards of resident care within the facility.
requirements: Minimum of 2 years of experience with MDS 3.0 in a skilled nursing facility
Strong understanding of federal and state regulations related to MDS and care planning

description: We are seeking a dedicated Registered Nurse (RN) to join a premier skilled nursing facility as an MDS Coordinator in Missouri Valley, IA. This full-time, permanent position offers a competitive annual salary of $65,000 - $75,000, providing an excellent opportunity for a professional looking to make a significant impact in patient care and regulatory compliance.As an MDS Coordinator, you will be instrumental in managing the Minimum Data Set (MDS) process, ensuring accurate assessments and comprehensive care planning for residents. This role requires a keen eye for detail and a commitment to maintaining high standards of quality and compliance within a supportive team environment. We are specifically looking for candidates interested in a long-term, full-time commitment.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa.
Minimum of 2 years of experience as an MDS Coordinator in a skilled nursing facility.
Proficiency with MDS 3.0 and comprehensive knowledge of federal and state regulations.
Must be seeking a permanent, full-time role; interim candidates will not be considered.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $65,000 - $75,000, based on experience.
